purpose: Prevent native-4K benchmark evidence from being captured against stale, merely-requested, or not-yet-finished realtime reflection cubemaps. This contract is implementation/evidence integrity only and cannot award Visual Fidelity points.

unityApiBasis.renderProbe: ReflectionProbe.RenderProbe returns a RenderID for the requested cubemap refresh.
unityApiBasis.completionCheck: ReflectionProbe.IsFinishedRendering(RenderID) is the completion check for a requested probe render; Unity's example checks it during later Update calls rather than assuming RenderProbe completed synchronously.
unityApiBasis.timeSlicing: ReflectionProbeTimeSlicingMode.NoTimeSlicing renders the probe entirely in one frame; one frame is not treated as proof of same-call-stack completion.
unityApiBasis.realtimeTexture: ReflectionProbe.realtimeTexture is the realtime cubemap resource used by the probe.

completionObservation.reason: RenderProbe schedules a render identified by RenderID. The capture pipeline must allow Unity to advance the frame that performs a NoTimeSlicing probe render before accepting completion.

preCaptureAlgorithm: Build, save, reopen and validate the final benchmark scene before requesting any realtime probe refresh.
Find and sort the two registered benchmark probes deterministically by name.
Force NoTimeSlicing immediately before still capture.
Call RenderProbe() for each probe and retain its returned RenderID; reject negative RenderIDs.
Return control to the Unity Editor and poll completion on subsequent EditorApplication.update callbacks instead of treating the RenderProbe call itself as a completed render frame.
While waiting, request PlayerLoop progression and SceneView repaint; abort after 30 seconds if completion cannot be proven.
Require RenderID >= 0 and IsFinishedRendering(RenderID) == true for every probe before any benchmark Camera.Render is accepted.
Require realtimeTexture to be non-null, created, Cube-dimensional, and exactly 512x512 per face.
Write reflection_probe_refresh_receipt.json with Unity version, graphics device, RenderIDs, completion flags and cubemap state only after all probes are complete.
Validate the runtime receipt, then capture hero/oblique/grazing without rebuilding scene geometry/materials between reflection synchronization and Camera.Render.
Abort native-4K capture if any requested probe is not proven complete and texture-ready.

criticalFailurePolicy.reason: A stale or unfinished reflection cubemap can make glass, aluminum, painted steel and wetness response appear plausible while not corresponding to the current sky/sun/scene state. Such pixels are not valid evidence for the lighting or material categories.

prohibitedClaims: Do not treat calling RenderProbe() alone as proof that the cubemap finished.
Do not treat an IsFinishedRendering check in the same RenderProbe call stack as sufficient evidence when Unity has not advanced a rendering frame.
Do not rebuild the benchmark after synchronization and then reuse the old completion receipt.
Do not set probesRefreshedImmediatelyBeforeCapture=true unless later-update completion/texture checks succeeded for the exact scene state being captured.
Do not infer visual quality from a successful synchronization receipt.
Do not award Lighting, Material/PBR or Cinematic points until the actual sealed 3840x2160 frames and 100% crops are reviewed.

expectedVisualScoreImpactAfterRealRender.lighting_shadows_reflections: reduces risk of stale or contradictory reflection evidence; points remain reviewer-observed only
expectedVisualScoreImpactAfterRealRender.material_pbr: makes angular/Fresnel review of glass and metal correspond to the current physical environment
expectedVisualScoreImpactAfterRealRender.cinematic_image: prevents exposure/composition review from being contaminated by stale specular energy

verification.note: Real Unity execution is mandatory. Until then this is Implementation Readiness only.
